title: Cassava and Savory Stir Fry with Vietnamese Spices
description: A flavorful and aromatic stir fry dish that combines the nutty taste of cassava with the savory flavors of French cuisine, featuring Vietnamese spices.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the cassava and cook for 5 minutes until slightly tender.
Add the savory and Vietnamese chili; stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot and garnish with additional Vietnamese chili if desired.
Ensure the cassava is cooked at a minimum internal temperature of 190°F (88°C).
Check the savory for safe cooking temperature and texture.
Adjust seasoning as needed before serving.
